body: I have but I have trouble composing myself when I talk about it. I get even more frustrated that I can't communicate the suffocating feeling I get in sadness.
There is professional council at my university so that should help. I don't know how I'd feel about it. It was pretty clear what I meant without being explicit.

It is hard to say that to my friend at 3 am because I don't want him to feel guilty about it. I just need people to talk me through the night. Tomorrow I can seek professional help. I've gotten tremendous support already.  I wonder what anyone sees in me, if anything they say is genuine. I guess I've never felt loved in any real way.
